title: Class 7 Mathematics - Geometry & Triangles MCQ Special

questions.question: In the right-angled triangle shown below, $AB = 6\text{ cm}$ and $BC = 8\text{ cm}$. What is the length of the hypotenuse $AC$?
Which of the following TikZ diagrams correctly represents an equilateral triangle where all three angles are equal to $60^\circ$?
questions.hint: An equilateral triangle has all 3 sides equal and all 3 interior angles equal to 60°.

options.explanation: Correct! This diagram shows an equilateral triangle with equal sides $a$ and $60^\circ$ angles.
This diagram shows a right-angled triangle, not an equilateral triangle.
This diagram shows a scalene triangle with unequal sides.
This diagram shows an isosceles triangle with an obtuse angle.

questions.explanation: Option A shows an equilateral triangle with 3 equal side lengths $a$ and interior angles of $60^\circ$.
